title: Rate-limited tenant drip switchover and rollback runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Private (VPC) customer upgrades of the inference data plane need an automated, auditable pathway that performs per-tenant traffic switchover with minimal blast radius and a deterministic rollback path. Current orchestrators either perform big-bang swaps or rely on coarse tenant slices which cause transient errors and KV cache miss storms for latency-sensitive workloads. This ticket defines a rate-limited "drip" switchover strategy, Terraform/IaC patterns, health checks, and an explicit rollback playbook for zero-downtime goals across private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform module (module.tenant_drip_swap) can target a tenant slice and apply a controlled traffic-rate delta without draining all connections at once.
Automated preflight checks (terraform plan + synthetic probe smoke) must block apply when >2 failing probes across 3 probesets.
Runtime orchestrator emits step-level events to the console and audit logs: start_slice, ramp_rate, probe_pass, commit_slice, rollback_slice.
Rollback reproduces the pre-swap traffic shaping state within 90s and restores KV cache priming hints to the previous variant when available.
Runbook tested end-to-end in staging with chaos injection (packet loss 1-2%, transient CPU spike) and meets SLOs: P99 latency regression <15% and error rate <0.5% above baseline.
Operators can run a one-line abort which triggers a fast-deceleration and snapshot-hedged rollback with clear console status and GitHub PR reference in the audit trail.
implementation_notes: Terraform: add module.tenant_drip_swap with inputs: tenant_id, target_runtime_version, max_ramp_qps, rate_step_ms, preflight_probe_set_id, preflight_threshold_pass_count.
Use 'terraform apply --target=module.tenant_drip_swap["slice-003"]' pattern to scope changes to single slice during manual interventions.
Orchestrator: implement token-bucket rate limiter per-tenant with an emergency-deceleration hook that reduces allowed QPS by 80% when synthetic probe failure ratio >0.02 for the last 2 minutes.
KV cache priming: orchestrator schedules a prioritized prewarm job that replays the recent hot prefixes for the slice to the new runtime variant before traffic ramp above 20%.
Telemetry hooks: emit metrics tenant.swap.step.<name> and events to console via the existing rollout-event bus. Ensure traces contain tenant_id and swap_id for easy correlation.
Safety: require a terraform plan approval step that includes the preflight probe snapshot and the expected traffic ramp timeline embedded in the PR description.
Conservative defaults: max_ramp_qps defaults to 5% of tenant baseline QPS per 60s step; allow override for low-traffic tenants.
Operator CLI: add 'redwoodctl private swap start --tenant-id <id> --target-version vX.Y --slice slice-003' which invokes the Terraform module and monitors probes until commit.
State locking: leverage existing terraform state locking and add a lease token for in-flight swaps to prevent concurrent swaps on overlapping tenant slices.
Audit: each swap writes a JSON summary to S3/audit-bucket with swap_id, operator, plan_hash, and preflight_probe_results for compliance teams.
test_plan: Unit tests for the rate limiter and emergency-deceleration logic with edge QPS patterns.
Integration test in staging: simulate a 500-tenant cluster, run a 10-slice drip swap over 30 minutes, inject 1% packet loss midway and assert automated deceleration engages and recovers.
Chaos test: CPU spike on 2/10 runtime nodes during ramp; verify rollback path restores traffic within 90s and no tenant-level tail latency SLO violations.
End-to-end manual validation checklist in staging: terraform plan review, start swap for slice, observe probe metrics pass, commit slice, repeat and trigger abort path.
Load test: ensure KV priming job completes within configured warmup window for 95% of tenants when ramp hits 20%.
Smoke: validate audit-trail entries exist for each step and link back to CI/GitHub PR used to trigger the swap.
rollback_playbook: Abort (soft): operator runs 'redwoodctl private swap abort --swap-id <swap_id>' which sets ramp rate to -100% (fast-deceleration) and stops new session admission on swapped nodes while routing existing sessions back to previous runtime variant.
Force rollback: 'terraform apply --target=module.tenant_drip_swap["slice-003"]' with variables rollback=true and instant=false performs grace drain with snapshot-hedging for in-flight KV.

Emergency rollback: set emergency_flagswap:<swap_id> in console which triggers immediate traffic re-route via control-plane override and sends a rollback_note to audit logs; used only if P0 impact or >0.8% customer errors.
KV reconciliation: run 'scripts/kv_reconcile --swap-id <swap_id> --direction revert' to rehydrate priming hints if the variant change was the source of miss storms.
Post-rollback verification: run preflight synthetic probes and require 10 consecutive probe windows passing before marking the rollback resolved.
Postmortem: create a postmortem ticket linked to swap_id and include terraform plan, probe logs, and timeline events; tag with root cause hypotheses and remediation actions.
run_commands_examples: redwoodctl private swap start --tenant-id tenant-42 --target-version runtime-2.3 --slice slice-003 --dry-run
comments: 2026-01-14 - Aisha Patel: Initial draft and goals posted. Called out Terraform module inputs and desired operator UX. Added dependency on ENG-412356 (staged-primingless-hotpatch-validator).

2026-01-28 - Marco Ruiz: Implemented proof-of-concept orchestrator hook that accepts rate_step_ms and emits metrics. Need to iterate on emergency-deceleration threshold — current hardcoded 2% is too sensitive in staging.

2026-02-11 - SRE Review (Lian Chen): Request to add more conservative defaults for max_ramp_qps and to surface preflight probe histograms in the console. Also asked for a TTL on swap lease tokens to prevent leak.

2026-02-25 - Security (Marina Gomez): Confirmed no new secrets; audit path must include plan_hash and operator; suggested adding KMS-wrapped audit log encryption for compliance. Marked security_review_required=false after discussion.

2026-03-03 - Marco Ruiz: Staging run completed. Observed KV priming jobs lagging on heavy tenants — adjusted prewarm concurrency to 4 and re-ran. One abort exercised successfully during simulated node CPU spike; logs attached to the PR.
2026-03-05 - Release Manager (Omar Singh): Added release tag private-runtime-2.3 and scheduled canary window 2026-03-21. Requested final runbook sign-off by 2026-03-18.
